children: Control Empresarial De Capitales S.A. De C.V., a 10% Owner, reported sales of Talos Energy common shares on October 15 and October 16, 2026. The October 15 sale of 52,000 shares was executed at a weighted average price of $17.0106 per share and the October 16 sale of 2,700,000 shares was executed at a weighted average price of $17.1937 per share. The total sale amount reported was $47,307,541. Following the reported transactions, the reporter directly owned 26,641,590 common shares. Exhibit 99.1 is incorporated by reference for ownership form details.
